text: ただし…　うまく　とれるか　どうかは　わからんぞ！

structure.jp: うまく　とれるか　どうかは
structure.en: whether you can catch it well or not

patterns.name: 〜かどうか
patterns.explanation: かどうか after a verb means 'whether or not'. とれるか　どうか = 'whether you can catch it or not'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん here is a short, rough form of ない, 'not', common in older men's speech. わからん = 'don't know'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, manly way to push your point at the listener. わからんぞ = 'there's no telling, mind you!'
